note: What a server sends to say one unit hurt another. A client shows the figure and nothing more: the health it shows for the unit is what replication carries, and this message leaves it as it was. The header names the unit hurt, as target does.

bits.name: result
bits.note: How the damage landed, and so what a client shows over the unit hurt. 4 shows the amount, 3 shows it as a critical strike, and 2 shows the word for a dodge in place of an amount.

5.name: miss
5.note: A notice in the dodge style.

bits.name: unused1
bits.note: A client does not read it.

bits.name: kind
bits.note: What sort of damage it is, which sets how a client colours the figure: 0 red, 1 purple and 2 white.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit dealing it. A client shows nothing, notices included, unless it holds both target and source; the figure drifts from source toward target, and a champion source has the amount added to its damage dealt.

fields.name: result
fields.note: How the damage landed, and so what a client shows over the unit hurt. A value of 6 shows the amount as normal does.

0.name: invulnerable
0.note: Shows that the unit could not be hurt.

2.name: dodged
2.note: Shows that the blow was dodged.

3.name: critical
3.note: Shows the amount as a critical strike.

fields.name: unknown1
fields.note: One byte between result and kind. Zero in everything observed. Setting any one of its bits, from 1 to 128, changes nothing a client shows.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of damage it is, which sets how a client colours the figure.

1.name: magical
1.note: Shown in its own colour, purple where critical.

2.name: true
2.note: Shown in its own colour, white where critical.

3.name: mixed
3.note: Shown as physical damage is, critical or not.
